definitions.full: H6803. tsintseneth צִנְצֶ֫נֶת noun feminine jar , or like receptacle (so vrss and context; perhaps from above v; > basket = ᵑ7 Talmud צִנָּא ); — Exod 16:33 (P). צְנָן see צַאֲנָן .

occurrences.englishText: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept throughout your generations.”
